dedupe_keys.name: voies cyclables du departement de haute savoie 2016 2020

description: Voies cyclables du département de Haute Savoie - 2016-2020 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de la Haute-Savoie. Bicycle paths in the department of Haute Savoie - 2016-2020 cycling74 Bicycle lanes, also called cycle lanes, are facilities dedicated to the circulation of bicycles. They are intended to encourage cycling as an alternative mode of transport, improve cyclist safety and reduce road congestion and greenhouse gas emissions. Coverage: Conseil Départemental de la Haute-Savoie. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle paths in the department of Haute Savoie - 2016-2020" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil Départemental de la Haute-Savoie. Its keywords include bande-cyclable, velos, voies-cyclables, itineraires-cyclables, sig, mobilite-et-transports. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, CSV, DXF, CPG. The listing shows 2024-07-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
